raw_posts.name: Clueso MCP
raw_posts.tagline: Create and edit videos by chatting
raw_posts.description: Make videos with Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent. Give Clueso an idea, deck, reference video, or recording, and it handles the whole video production: storyboard, scenes, voiceover, music, and editing, on-brand. Everything stays editable, by hand or by chat.

raw_posts.name: WZRD
raw_posts.tagline: AI-native documents, slides, forms and sheets that talk back
raw_posts.description: WZRD is for teams and creators working with documents, slides, forms and sheets. Upload existing work or create from a prompt, then turn it into an AI experience users can engage with. Forms collect answers by speaking or typing. Sheets explain numbers out loud. Slides walk people through the story. Documents engage every user. The output stays conversational and responsive.

raw_posts.name: Anomalo
raw_posts.tagline: Your data is always talking. Don't miss what it's saying.
raw_posts.description: Your data changes constantly. Anomalo Analyst tells you what matters before you know to ask. It proactively monitors your Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery data, surfaces important trends, anomalies, and shifts, and lets you investigate with follow-up questions in plain language. Every insight is verified against your data, with Anomalo helping distinguish real business changes from broken data.

raw_posts.name: SereneDB
raw_posts.tagline: Ultra-Fast Search & Analytics Database, Agentic AI ready
raw_posts.description: SereneDB is the result of 12 years of development - an open-source database that does ultra-fast full-text and fast analytics in one engine. Postgres- and Elastic-compatible: keep your SQL, your drivers, and your Elastic clients; drop the second system and the ETL between them. In our public benchmark, it outperforms Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, and Postgres search extensions, and indexes 1B logs in under 8 minutes at ~10x less disk. Apache 2.0, methodology, and raw results are public.

raw_posts.name: thestory.run
raw_posts.tagline: A writing coach for corporate influencers.
raw_posts.description: Your team already has things to say, they just don't know how. Our coach helps you stay consistent, find stories worth sharing and makes YOU the writer. Most AI tools take over writing. thestory.run flips it: the coach interviews you, finds the point you're circling, hands you the story arc, and you write it. It is the coach that helps you through it all: One real session, from a messy thought to a finished post. Between the posts, it keeps the week so you never have to guess what's next

raw_posts.name: Freebuff Ads
raw_posts.tagline: Advertise to 500k developers in our coding agent
raw_posts.description: Run ads inside the Freebuff desktop app, mobile, web, and CLI - where 500k developers are already working. Pay per click, set your own caps, and measure clicks and conversions in one console.

raw_posts.name: PixelCrew
raw_posts.tagline: Production-ready design from a crew of AI agents
raw_posts.description: A crew of specialized AI agents coordinates on your brief and ships production-quality design. Research, creative direction, wireframes, and production-ready HTML with a design system. You can watch the agents discuss decisions while it runs. Free in alpha: bring your own OpenRouter key and run the crew on whichever models you like.

raw_posts.name: Plane Agents
raw_posts.tagline: Assign work to AI agents, like any teammate
raw_posts.description: Plane Agents join your workspace as members. Assign them work items, tag them, trigger them when work changes, or run them on a schedule. They triage requests, draft specs, run standups, flag delivery risks and a lot more. Agents run on the AI credits included in every paid plan.

raw_posts.name: MiMo-V2.6
raw_posts.tagline: Open omnimodal intelligence, trained in public
raw_posts.description: MiMo-V2.6 is Xiaomi’s open omnimodal model family for long-horizon agent work. Pro and Flash handle text, images, audio and video with 1M context, while Xiaomi is also releasing the technical report, RL environments and training code behind the public post-training run.

raw_posts.name: Pulsetic RUM
raw_posts.tagline: Uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors
raw_posts.description: Pulsetic is uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors too. One async script reports Core Web Vitals, load-time percentiles and the JavaScript errors they hit, sliced by page, country, browser and device, so you catch the slow checkout that a 200 response code hides. Ask Pulsetic AI what broke last night in plain language. Cron heartbeats, domain expiry and branded status pages run in the same account.
